instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use 'Handjet' font for all Arabic text. It is the ONLY pixel-style font that supports Arabic well.
CRITICAL: Implement a 'Language Toggle' that switches between LTR (English) and RTL (Arabic). Ensure the layout flips correctly.
CRITICAL: Use the provided Logo and Cover image. The Cover image should be used in the Hero section, potentially with a pixelation filter or overlay.
STYLE: Do NOT use rounded corners (rounded-none). Everything must be sharp and blocky.
STYLE: Use the 'CRT Overlay' effect (scanlines) on the entire body to give it a retro screen feel.
FORM: Break the form into steps (Wizard). Do not show a long scrolling form. Use a 'Progress Bar' that looks like a Health Bar.
INPUTS: Checkboxes should look like [ ] and [x] in pixel art style (custom CSS).
ANIMATION: Use 'framer-motion' for page transitions. Slide sections in like a game level loading.
THEME: Force Dark Mode. There is no Light Mode for this app.
ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure the Red (#FF3B3B) text is only used on dark backgrounds where contrast is sufficient. Use White for main body text.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'AI slop' designs. Be bold with spacing and typography.
Use 'lucide-react' for icons, but try to stick to square/blocky icons where possible.
All interactive elements must have 'data-testid' attributes.
